notes: The minifigure assembly (helmet, visor, head, torso, legs) is not in the parts list or catalogue, so it is omitted.
Element numbers were mapped to part types: 371001 = Plate 1x4 (lego-3710), 4233486 = Technic brick 1x2 (lego-32064b), 3005743 = Trans-Dark Blue round plate (lego-6141).

The booklet is ambiguous about which pieces touch in steps 2-3. I assumed the two 1x2 plates and the black brick each attach to the curved wedge, the 1x4 plate bridges the two 1x2 plates, and the two slopes attach to the 2x6 plate.
The 2x6 plate also sits under the black brick, but I did not add that edge.
Ports are null because the exact stud positions are unclear from the images.
The hinge top plate is the second 393726 callout in the sub-assembly (lego-3938, element 393801).
Page 2 has steps 5 and 6. The rest of the page is advertising and adds nothing.

Step 5 sub-assembly: axle 4263624 (lego-59426) goes into the angled connector 4118981 (lego-32013), and pin 4211807 (lego-3673) goes into the connector's pin hole. The axle's other end passes through the axle hole of the Technic brick (b12).
The windscreen's attachment points are not clear from the picture. I assumed it sits on the 2x2 plate (b4) and the 1x4 plate (b9).
The tile with pin (b18) is assumed to sit on the hinge top plate (b14).
The 9-inch propeller (b22) goes on the tile's top pin, and the 5.5-inch propeller (b23) goes on the tail pin (b21).
The trans-yellow round plate (3005744) is the third lego-6141 and fits on the camera piece (b24).
The two equipment pieces (b24, b26) are shown low on each side of the cockpit. I assumed they clip to the black 2x6 plate (b7).
